`@quasar/app-vite` recursively removes `build.distDir` before producing build artifacts. The configured path was made absolute, but it was not checked before removal. A configuration mistake could therefore target the project root, user home directory, a filesystem root, or another directory outside the project.

## Details

The build command and mode builders passed the resolved output directory directly to `fs-extra` recursive removal. Existing symlink ancestors were not resolved before deletion either, so a path that appeared to be inside the project could operate on a directory outside it.

`quasar.config` is trusted application code, and no attacker-controlled input reaches `build.distDir` by default. This issue is primarily destructive-build safety hardening. It can become a security boundary when build configuration is generated or influenced by less-trusted automation.

## Impact

Running a normal Quasar build with an unsafe `build.distDir` can delete data accessible to the build user before compilation begins.

## Remediation

Validate the effective deletion target before every artifact cleanup. Always reject filesystem roots, the user home directory and the project root; resolve existing symlink ancestors; require an explicit `build.allowOutsideProjectDistDir` opt-in for external output directories; and log the exact resolved target before removal.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-q9mq-245r-4g93", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-07T16:14:35Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q9mq-245r-4g93", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-q9mq-245r-4g93"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-106109"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-10-06T18:16:52Z", "published_at": "2026-10-07T16:14:35Z", "references": ["https://github.com/quasarframework/quasar/security/advisories/GHSA-q9mq-245r-4g93", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-106109", "https://github.com/quasarframework/quasar/commit/6c009734b406e246a0855ed060e3a822de8aecc1", "https://github.com/quasarframework/quasar/releases/tag/@quasar/app-vite-v3.3.0", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q9mq-245r-4g93"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/quasarframework/quasar/security-advisories/GHSA-q9mq-245r-4g93", "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/quasarframework/quasar", "summary": "Quasar Framework: App Vite build cleanup can recursively remove unsafe configured output directories", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-07T16:14:36Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-q9mq-245r-4g93", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "3.3.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "@quasar/app-vite"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 1.0.0, <= 3.2.0"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
